feedback: Your essay presents a clear stance on the need for a balanced cellphone policy in South African schools. You successfully identified key issues such as digital equity and classroom distractions, which shows a good understanding of the topic's complexity. To improve, ensure that your specific recommendations are consistent throughout the piece; at one point you suggest phones should only be used at break, but later you argue for their use in planned lessons. Additionally, try to vary your phrasing. The phrase 'planning homework reminders' appears in two different paragraphs to support different ideas, which makes the writing feel repetitive. Expanding your vocabulary will help you express these distinct points more effectively. Overall, your structure is logical and your tone is well-suited for a formal discussion on school policy.
